attributes.readMe:
## Interview

A plain chat. The interviewer asks one question at a time, follows up on real moments, notices contradictions, and pulls up a tool when a measure beats a sentence: Quick pick, Scale and ladders, This or that, Off the top of your head, Haggle, **Picture it** (describe something, the AI draws it, change it until it feels right) and **Watch it** (react to a video, camera optional).

Every turn is a fresh agent that sees only the brief, the **dossier** (aims, what we know, how to talk to this person, next moves) and recent turns, so an interrupted interview just carries on. A running **verdict** keeps each measure's lean, confidence and evidence; finishing early gives an honest result, with unsure parts left unsure.

The interviewer's **talking portrait** opens beside the chat and lip-syncs each line; close it any time, and click their picture to bring it back.
attributes.cardDescription: One person's interview: a chat with an AI interviewer who works from the brief, pulls up question tools when talk isn't enough, and keeps a living dossier any agent can carry on from.
